title: CancelTurnParams
description:
Params of the `engine/cancel_turn` RPC.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::CancelTurnParams; let p: CancelTurnParams = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"threadId":"thread:native/x"}"#).unwrap(); assert_eq!(p.thread_id.0.as_ref(), "thread:native/x"); ```

threadId.description: Thread whose active turn should be cancelled.
